name: Pairing coordinator
design: Lean adult male with russet-brown mottled hide, narrow angular skull, exposed four mandibles, dreadlocks gathered into one high rear knot. Charcoal long-sleeved tunic with broad honey-ochre V-shaped overlay, short black split skirt panels over trousers, bronze belt clasps. Holds two flat unmarked contender token disks of slightly different shapes in one hand while checking wrist reader with the other; neutral official stance.
